articles.title: OKX's Rafique doubts Clarity Act will pass, warns optimism is already priced into bitcoin
articles.snippet: The OKX executive says Democrats have little incentive to hand Republicans a crypto victory before the midterms.

articles.title: BIP-110 Bitcoin branch stalls after two blocks as gap widens
articles.snippet: The enforcing fork remains stuck at Bitcoin’s full mining difficulty as mandatory signaling proceeds with little hashpower support.

articles.title: US Treasury’s OFAC sanctions 2 Iran-linked crypto exchanges
articles.snippet: The US government sanctioned an individual and two crypto exchanges it said facilitated money laundering for a combined $5 million in digital assets linked to Iran.

articles.title: Reform UK chair calls for probe into SBF-linked donation: Report
articles.snippet: As the chairman of the Reform UK calls for an investigation into a FTX-linked political donation, the party’s leader prepares to face voters amid his own crypto-related scandal.

articles.title: Bitcoin Red Team Says AI Is Finding Critical Exploits Across Core Projects
articles.snippet: A volunteer security effort says it has scanned 150 Bitcoin repositories, disclosed more than a dozen vulnerabilities, and is building an open-source AI platform to automate software security reviews.
